collision_candidates_scores.name: collision_candidates_scores
collision_candidates_scores.value: "collision_candidates"."relevance" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "collision_candidates"."novelty" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "collision_candidates"."tension_fit" BETWEEN 0 AND 1

resolutions_resolved_selection.name: resolutions_resolved_selection
resolutions_resolved_selection.value: ("entity_resolution_records"."status" <> 'RESOLVED') OR ("entity_resolution_records"."selected_entity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "entity_resolution_records"."method" IS NOT NULL)

hypotheses_score_range.name: hypotheses_score_range
hypotheses_score_range.value: ("hypotheses"."support_score" IS NULL OR "hypotheses"."support_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100) AND ("hypotheses"."novelty_score" IS NULL OR "hypotheses"."novelty_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100) AND ("hypotheses"."feasibility_score" IS NULL OR "hypotheses"."feasibility_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100) AND ("hypotheses"."composite_score" IS NULL OR "hypotheses"."composite_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
